rows.what_the_ink_shows: The lower-right marginal statement displays $H^i(\operatorname{Spec}(\mathbf Z),\mathbf Q(n))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^i(U,\mathbf Q(n))$, followed by the open-subscheme condition and the unmistakable words/symbols "et $n\neq0$ (tout $i$)". The digit after the inequality is a small closed oval, with no upright stroke for 1 and no cancellation or replacement attached to it. See crops/15_scan173_L181_L299_margin.jpg for the whole marginal assertion and crops/15_scan173_L181_L299_condition.jpg for the enlarged condition.
rows.note: This row and L299 target the same physical marginal assertion. Written: $n\neq0$. Intended mathematical condition proposed by the correction rows: $n\neq1$. Retain the written condition because the original LaTeX accurately transcribes the ink. The supplied references to 15:174, another witness, and Michel Hua were not independently inspected; no purity, Gysin, or cohomology calculation was performed in this review.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Visually inspected the full assigned scan and two enlarged contrast-raised crops of the lower-right marginal statement. Confirmed the manuscript writes $n\neq0$, as the assigned LaTeX does. Classified the proposed $n\neq1$ as (b) and made no transcription edit.
